function.description: Semantic token autocomplete — understands '100 usdc on ethereum'.
function.name: khalani__tokens__autocomplete

chainIds.description: Comma-separated chain IDs or aliases. Accepts either a comma-separated string ("1,8453") or an array of strings (["1","8453"]) — the two are equivalent.

limit.description: Max results. Range 1-20 (provider maximum, default 10); anything else is rejected before the call.
